events.title: Joomla 2.5 released
events.summary: The Joomla project shipped Joomla 2.5 on January 24, 2012 — the first long-term support release in the 2.x series.
events.about: Joomla 2.5 added one-click core updates, multi-language support in core, and a refined ACL system — bridging Joomla 1.5 sites toward the Bootstrap-based Joomla 3 admin. It was the stable branch most production Joomla sites ran through the early 2010s.

narrative.whyChosen: Joomla 2.5 was the LTS release that carried the Joomla ecosystem through the 2.x era.
narrative.whyImportant: Core multilingual support and one-click updates reduced upgrade friction for thousands of sites.
narrative.problemSolved: Joomla 1.5 sites needed a supported path forward with modern security and localization.
